title: After 25 Years, Physicists Can Finally Measure The 'Other' Kind of Quantum Entanglement
key_facts: Kyoto and Hiroshima University physicists measured W-state entanglement
Previously GHZ states could be measured
One-shot measurement using a discrete Fourier transform optical circuit
quote_evidence: we have finally obtained the entangled measurement for the W state as well, with genuine experimental demonstration for 3-photon W states
The team now plans to develop on-chip photonic quantum circuits for these entangled measurements.
why_it_matters_hint: Faster entanglement measurement for photonic quantum tech.
notes: Underlying paper published September 2025 (day not given); article published 5 Oct 2026, so score lowered by 2.
